# Taste Skill — Anti-Slop Frontend Framework for AI Agents

**taste-skill** is an opinionated design engineering framework created to solve "AI Slop" — the generic, uninspired, cookie-cutter interfaces generated by default by coding agents. It provides battle-tested principles for typography, layout hierarchy, micro-interactions, and visual weight.

- **Upstream Repository:** [https://github.com/leonxlnx/taste-skill](https://github.com/leonxlnx/taste-skill)
- **Official Portal:** [https://tasteskill.dev](https://tasteskill.dev)
- **Primary Goal:** Transform generic "AI boilerplate" frontends into bespoke, premium products.

---

## 🚫 What is "AI Slop" & How Taste Skill Solves It

| AI Slop Anti-Pattern | Taste Skill Solution |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Monotonous Card Grids:** Repetitive 3-column cards with identical padding and icons. | **Asymmetric & Editorial Flow:** Varied focal points, typographic dominance, bento grids with deliberate hierarchy. |
| **Generic Purple/Blue Buttons:** Cliché gradients (`indigo-600` to `purple-600`) with bloated shadows. | **Restrained Palette & High-Contrast Accents:** Deep neutral foundations (`#0A0A0C`), crisp 1px borders, single high-impact accent. |
| **Browser Default Typography:** Standard Inter without optical sizing or letter-spacing tuning. | **Bespoke Typographic System:** Negative letter-spacing (`-0.02em` to `-0.04em`) on display headers, tabular figures on metrics, editorial leading. |
| **Instant Abrupt State Changes:** Jumpy modal opens, instant hover color flips. | **Intentional Physics & Micro-Motion:** Cubic-bezier transitions (e.g. `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`), smooth spring-like feel. |

---

## 🎨 Core Architectural Pillars

### 1. Visual Weight & Hierarchy (Anti-Boilerplate)
- Every screen must have **one clear hero anchor** before the user scrolls.
- Use whitespace as a structural divider instead of stacking border lines everywhere.
- Eliminate decorative nonsense (meaningless floating shapes or gradient blobs).

### 2. Typographic Discipline
- **Display Headings:** Large scale, tight tracking, editorial weights (600/700).
- **Body Text:** Muted contrast for secondary text (`#9CA3AF`), never pure 50% opacity gray that fails WCAG.
- **Data & Numbers:** Monospace/tabular fonts for tables, tickers, and financial cards.

### 3. Surface & Elevation Architecture
- Avoid heavy CSS `box-shadow: 0 20px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)`.
- Use **multi-layered micro-shadows** with low opacity and 1px borders with inner glow (`inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`).

---

## 🛠️ How Agents Apply This Skill

When asked to "design a page", "make this look great", or "refactor frontend UI":
1. **Audit:** Identify and strip out generic AI patterns (cliché purple gradients, repetitive cards).
2. **Apply Taste Tokens:** Inject refined color palettes, tight font tracking, and subtle elevation tokens.
3. **Motion Check:** Add purposeful hover transitions with organic easing curves.

---

## 💡 When to Recommend this Skill

- When an interface looks generic, robotic, or like a standard Bootstrap/Tailwind template.
- When the user complains that "it looks like AI generated this".
